title: Listening Drill — Outdoor drawing class — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Outdoor drawing class — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on outdoor drawing class last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with windy conditions. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: torn sheet.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of wind direction so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow sketch book instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the drawing tutor before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Friday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
